{"verses":[{"text":"Behold, food will be so cheap on earth that they will think themselves to be in good condition, and even then calamities will grow on earth: sword, famine, and great confusion.","verse":21,"chapter":16},{"text":"For many of those who dwell on earth will perish of famine; and others who escape the famine, the sword will destroy.","verse":22,"chapter":16},{"text":"The dead will be cast out like dung, and there will be no one to comfort them; for the earth will be left desolate, and its cities will be cast down.","verse":23,"chapter":16},{"text":"There will be no farmer left to cultivate the earth or to sow it.","verse":24,"chapter":16},{"text":"The trees will give fruit, but who will gather it?","verse":25,"chapter":16},{"text":"The grapes will ripen, but who will tread them? For in all places there will be a great solitude;","verse":26,"chapter":16},{"text":"for one man will desire to see another, or to hear his voice.","verse":27,"chapter":16},{"text":"For of a city there will be ten left, and two of the field, who have hidden themselves in the thick groves, and in the clefts of the rocks.","verse":28,"chapter":16},{"text":"As in an orchard of olives upon every tree there may be left three or four olives,","verse":29,"chapter":16},{"text":"or as when a vineyard is gathered, there are some clusters left by those who diligently search through the vineyard,","verse":30,"chapter":16},{"text":"even so in those days, there will be three or four left by those who search their houses with the sword.","verse":31,"chapter":16},{"text":"The earth will be left desolate, and its fields will be for briers, and its roads and all her paths will grow thorns, because no sheep will pass along them.","verse":32,"chapter":16},{"text":"The virgins will mourn, having no bridegrooms. The women will mourn, having no husbands. Their daughters will mourn, having no helpers.","verse":33,"chapter":16},{"text":"Their bridegrooms will be destroyed in the wars, and their husbands will perish of famine.","verse":34,"chapter":16},{"text":"Hear now these things, and understand them, you servants of the Lord.","verse":35,"chapter":16},{"text":"Behold, the Lord’s word: receive it. Don’t doubt the things about which the Lord speaks.","verse":36,"chapter":16},{"text":"Behold, the calamities draw near, and are not delayed.","verse":37,"chapter":16},{"text":"Just as a woman with child in the ninth month, when the hour of her delivery draws near, within two or three hours great pains surround her womb, and when the child comes out from the womb, there will be no waiting for a moment,","verse":38,"chapter":16},{"text":"even so the calamities won’t delay coming upon the earth. The world will groan, and sorrows will seize it on every side.","verse":39,"chapter":16},{"text":"“O my people, hear my word: prepare for battle, and in those calamities be like strangers on the earth.","verse":40,"chapter":16}],"chapter":16,"book_code":"2ES"}
